verification_note: verification is NOT_VERIFIED unless a sample was opened on that surface and the result was recorded. Declared support is not a playback sign-off. No row in this file is VERIFIED_LOCAL.

deployment.note: MEDIA_USER_HOST and MEDIA_ADMIN_HOST are empty. This repository does not invent host addresses. Local smoke uses 127.0.0.1 only and is not a deployed MEDIA host.
